services.name: Cruise Now
services.desc: Expand your trip with our two-day hop-on hop-off exploration tour, which also includes a Millionaire’s Row cruise and a Night adventure tour. Immerse yourself in the charm of the city and discover its hidden gems with Bus Tours in Miami, Florida. The Night experience begins 75-90-minute panoramic Miami Night Tour to discover the Magic City all lit up for the evening. Our live guides will introduce you to Miami’s best sights after dark. Experience Miami’s panoramic views aboard the Miami Double Decker Bus Tour. Enjoy the vibrant buzz on South Beach’s Ocean Drive and discover the city’s best landmarks as they’re illuminated in the evening. Experience the city’s allure with the Bus Touristique

blurb: Island Queen Cruises & Tours operates sightseeing and party cruises from Bayside Marketplace in Miami, showcasing Miami's skyline, Millionaire's Row, and other attractions. They also offer bus tours, Everglades experiences, ferry trips to Bimini, and private yacht charters. Their fleet includes several yachts with air conditioning and bars, and they provide bilingual tours and various ticket options.
extraNote: Reservations required for groups of 20 or more; recommended for specific trip times · Cruises operate rain or shine; cancellations only for extreme weather · Tickets valid any day; can be used on another day if missed · Bayside Marketplace, 401 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, Florida 33132
